name: Calendar Search Criteria 1
definition: Defines the criteria used to search for calendar data.

Year.name: Year
Year.definition: Specifies the year for which the calendar information must be returned.

Month.name: Month
Month.definition: Specifies the month for which the calendar information must be returned.

Service.name: Service
Service.definition: Specifies the service or system for which the calendar information must be returned.
